m: परि-√ भास् Ā. -भासते, to appear, ŚBr.
परि-भासित mfn. (fr. Caus.) embellished, adorned, Cat.

s: puM, (pari + BU + “parO Buvo'vajYAne .” 3 । 3 । 55 । iti GaY .) pariBavaH । ityamaraH । 1 । 7 । 22 ॥
m: परि-भाव (also परि-भ्˚) m. contempt, Pañc. i, 258/259 (B. ˚भव).
a: परिभावः — See परिभव.
परिभावनं — Union, cohesion. --नं, --ना Contemplation, meditation.

v: tri॰ pari + BU--grahA॰ BUte'rTe Rini । sarvatoBAvena Bavanayukte striyAM NIp ।
m: परि-भाविन् mfn. injuring, despising, slighting, mocking, defying (ifc.), Kālid.; Ratnāv.
a: परिभाविन् — a. (नी f.) 1 Humiliating, despising, treating with contempt; Ś. 4. --2 Putting to shame, surpassing, excelling. --3 Setting at naught, defying; वैद्ययत्नपरिभाविनं गदं R. 19. 53 ‘defying medical remedies’.
परिभावित — p. p. 1 Contained, included. --2 Pervaded. --3 Penetrated. --4 Conceived.

m: परि-भावुक mf(ई)n. who or what shames or humbles or outstrips another (with acc.), Śiś.
a: परिभावुक — a. Contemning, shaming &c.

m: परि-√ भाष् Ā. -भाषते, to speak to (acc.), address, admonish, MBh.; Hariv.; R.; to declare, teach, explain, define, Gṛhyās.; Hariv., Kāś.; to persuade, exhort, encourage, MW.; to abuse, Divyāv.
a: परिभाष् — {c1c} A. 1 To lay down a convention, speak conventionally. --2 To speak to, address. --3 To teach, explain, interpret, expound. --4 To exhort, encourage.

s: strI, (pari + BAz + ac । tatazwAp । parizkftaM BAzaRam । padArTavivecakAcAryyARAM yuktiyuktA vAk । iti kAvyaprakASawIkAyAM caRqIdAsaH ॥ tatparyyAyaH । prajYaptiH 2 SElI 3 saNketaH 4 samayakAraH 5 । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ (sUtralakzaRaviSezaH । sUtraM zaqviDam । yaTA, -- “saM jYA ca pariBAzA ca viDirniyama eva ca । atideSo'DikAraSca zaqviDaM sUtralakzaRam ॥”) “granTasya saMkzepanirvvAhArTasaNketaviSezaH । yaTA capoditetyAdi .” iti mugDaboDawIkAyAM durgAdAsaH ॥ yaTA mAGe । 16 । 80 । “na Kalu pratihanyate kutaScit pariBAzeva garIyasI yadAjYA ॥” (“avyaktAnuktaleSoktasandigDArTaprakASikAH । pariBAzAH pravakzyante dIpIBUtAH suniScitAH ॥” iti vEdyakapariBAzAyA lakzaRam ॥ “praTamaM pariBAzA syAdBezajyAKyAnakantaTA .” iti SArNgaDare pUrvvaKaRqe praTame'DyAye ॥)
v: strI pari + BAza--a । SAstrakftAM 1 kfttimasaMjYAyAm avayavArTamanAdftya samudAyArTe 2 viSizwasaMjYAyAm । saMjYApariBAzayostu avAntaraBedaH pariBAzenduSeRare “yaToddeSaM saMjYApariBAzam “yaTAkAlaM saMjYApariBAzam” anayorvyAKyAne dfSyaH । “kaScidekadeSasTaH sarvaSAstramaBijvalayati yaTA pradIpaH suprajvalitaH sarvaM veSmABijvalayatIti “bazWI sTAne” iti sUtre BAzye uktam । “aDikAraSabdena pArAryyAt pariBAzApyucyate । kaScit pariBAzArUpa iti” kEyaQaH । dIpo yaTA praBAdvArA sarvagfhaprakASaka evametat । svabudDijananadvArA sarvaSAstropakArakamiti tattAtparyam । 4 ADunikasaNkete pAriBAzikaSabde dfSyam ।
m: परि-भाषा f. speech, discourse, words, MBh.; BhP.
blame, censure, reproof (only pl.), Pat.; Bālar.
any explanatory rule or general definition, (in gram.) a rule or maxim which teaches the proper interpretation or application of other rules, Pāṇ.
a table or list of abbreviations or signs used in any work
a: परिभाषा — 1 Speech, discourse. --2 Censurc, reproof, blame, abuse. --3 An explanation. --4 Terminology, technical phraseology, technical terms (used in a work); इति परिभाषाप्रकरणं Sk.; इको गुणवृद्धीत्यादिका परिभाषा Mbh. --5 (Hence) Any general rule, precept, or definition which is applicable throughout ( अनियमनिवारको न्यायविशेषः); परितः प्रमिताक्षरापि सर्वं विषयं प्राप्तवती गता प्रतिष्ठां . न खलु प्रतिहन्यते कदाचित् परिभाषेव गरीयसी यदाज्ञा Śi. 16. 80. --6 A list of abbreviations or signs used in any work. --7 (In gram.) An explanatory Sūtra mixed up with the other Sūtras of Pāṇini, which teaches the method of applying them. --8 (In medicine) Prognosis.

m: परि-भाषणीय mfn. to be addressed or spoken to

s: klI, (pari + BAz + lyuw .) saninda upAlamBaH । ityamaraH । 1 । 6 । 14 ॥ upAlamBo durvvAdaH । nindayA saha varttamAno ya upAlamBastatra saninde pariBAzaRam । upAlamBo guRAvizkaraRena stutipUrvvako'pi Bavati । yaTA mahAkulasya BavataH kimidamucitaM Bavati । atra tu sastutO na pariBAzaRam । wIkAntare'pi banDulasya tavAgamyAgamanaM yogyamiti nindApUrvvaH । mahAkulasya tava kaTaM viprabaDaH । iti stutipUrvvaSca upAlamBaH । iti BarataH ॥ * ॥ niyamaH । iti medinI ॥ AlApaH । iti viSvaH ॥
v: na॰ pari + BAza--lyuw । 1 nindayA duzwavacane AlApe 2 niyame ca medi॰ ।
m: परि-भाषण n. speaking, talking, discourse, Subh.
admonition, reprimand, reproof, Mn.; MBh.; Lalit.
a: परिभाषणं — 1 Speaking, discourse, talking, chatting, gossiping. --2 Expression of censure, admonition, reproof, abuse. --3 Rule, precept.

k.v: पारुष्यमतिवादः स्याद्भर्त्सनं त्वपकारगीः। यः सनिन्द उपालम्भस्तत्र स्यात्परिभाषणम्.।

m: परि-भाषित mfn. explained, said, stated as (nom.), taught, established as a rule, formed or used technically, Hariv.; Bālar.; Bījag.
परि-भाष्य mfn. to be stated or taught (अ-परिभ्˚), Pat.

परि-√ भू P. Ā. -भवति, ˚ते (pf. -बभूव, ˚भूथ, ˚भूवुः, RV.; aor. -अभूवन्, -भुवत्; Subj. -भूतस्, -भूथस्, ib.; Impv. -भूतु, ib.; Ved. inf. -भ्वे, ib.; ind.p. -भूय, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Pass. -भूयते, R.; fut. -भविष्यते, Bhaṭṭ.), to be round anything, surround, enclose, contain, RV.; AV.; Br.; to go or fly round, accompany, attend to, take care of, guide, govern, RV.; AV.; to be superior, excel, surpass, subdue, conquer, RV. &c. &c.; to pass round or over, not heed, slight, despise, insult, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to disgrace, MBh.; to disappear, be lost (= परा-भू), ib. : Caus. -भावयति, ˚ते (ind.p. -भाव्य), to spread around, divulge, make known, Uttarar.; to surpass, exceed, BhP.; to soak, saturate, sprinkle, Suśr.; ŚārṅgS.; to contain, include, BhP.; to conceive, think, consider, know, recognise as (acc.), Prab.; Rājat.; BhP.; Pañc.
परि-भू mfn. surrounding, enclosing, containing, pervading, guiding, governing, RV.; AV.; TS.; TBr.; ĪśUp.
a: परिभू — {c1c} P. 1 To defeat, subdue, conquer, overcome; (hence) to surpass, excel; लग्नद्वि फं परिभूय पद्मं Ku. 7. 16; R. 10. 35. --2 To despise, slight, treat with contempt, disrespect, insult; मा मां महात्मन् परिभ्रः Bk. 1. 22; 4. 37. --3 To injure, destroy, ruin. --4 To afflict, grieve. --5 To humiliate, disgrace. --6 To disappear. --7 Ved. To surround, encircle. --8 To go or fly round. --9 To accompany. --10 To take care of. --11 To guide, govern. --Caus. 1 To think of, reflect on, meditate, contemplate; U. 7. 20. --2 To contain, include. --3 To make known.

s: tri, (pariBUyate sma । pari + BU + ktaH .) anAdftam । tatparyyAyaH । avagaRitam 2 avamatam 3 avajYAtam 4 avamAnitam 5 । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 106 । aBiBUtam 6 । iti jawADaraH ॥ aprastutam 7 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, sArAvalyAM viMSADyAye । “pariBUtaM suKarahitaM kulawAputtramatipAparataYca । janayati nakzatrapatiH kzitisutadfzwo Jazi SUram ॥”)
v: tri॰ pari + BU--kta । 1 tiraskate 2 anAdfte ca hemaca॰
m: परि-भूत mfn. overpowered, conquered, slighted, disregarded, despised, Kāv.; Pur.
परि-भूत m. (with भट्ट) N. of a poet, Cat.

k.v: त्रातं त्राणं रक्षितमवितं गोपायितं च गुप्तं च। अवगणितमवमतावज्ञातेऽवमानितं च परिभूते॥

m: परि-भूत—गति-त्रय mfn. surpassing three times the age of man, BhP.
contempt, humiliation, disrespect, injury, Kathās.; Pañc.; BhP.
a: परिभूतिः — f. Contempt, insult, disrespect, humiliation; Mu. 4. 11.

m: परि-√ भूष् P. -भूषति, to run round, circumambulate, RV.; to wait upon, serve, attend, honour, obey, follow, ib.; to fit out, decorate, ib. ; to be superior, surpass in (instr.), ib. ii, 12, 1.
a: परिभूष् — {c10c} U. 1 To decorate, adorn. --2 To serve, wait upon. --3 To honour, worship. --4 To take care of. --5 To observe, follow. --6 To prepare, equip.

m: परि-भूषण m. (sc. संधि) peace obtained by the cession of the whole revenue of a land, Kām. (v.l. पर-भ्˚).
a: परिभूषणः — (scil. संधि) Peace obtained by the cession of the whole revenue of a land.
परिभंगः — Shattering, breaking to pieces.

m: परि-भङ्ग m. breaking to pieces, shattering, W.
परि-भग्न mfn. (√ भञ्ज्) broken, interrupted, disturbed, stopped, MBh.; R.
परि-भग्न—क्रम mfn. stopped in one's course, checked in one's progress, MBh.
परि-√ भज् (only ind.p. -भज्य), to divide, MBh.
परि-√ भक्ष् P. -भक्षयति, to drink or eat up (esp. what belongs to another), devour, consume, MBh.
परि-भक्षा f. passing over any one at a meal, N. of a partic. observance, ĀpŚr.
परि-भक्षण n. eating up, consuming, MBh.
परि-भक्षित mfn. drunk or eaten up, devoured, consumed, ŚāṅkhBr.; Lāṭy., Sch.; MBh.
परि-√ भर्त्स् P. -भर्त्सति, or -भर्त्सयति, to threaten, menace, scold, chide, MBh.; R.

a: परिभर्त्सनं — Threatening, menacing.

s: puM, (pari + BU + ap .) anAdaraH । ityamaraH । 1 । 7 । 22 ॥ (yaTA, raGuH । 12 । 37 । “PalamasyopahAsasya sadyaH prApsyasi paSya mAM । mfgyAH pariBavo vyAGryAmityavehi tvayA kftam ॥”)
v: pu॰ pari + BU--ap GaY vA । 1 anAdare 2 tiraskAre amaraH ।

a: परि(री)भवः — 1 Insult, injury, humiliation, disrespect, degradation, disgrace; पराक्रमः परिभवे वैयात्यं सुरतेष्विव (भूषणं) Śi. 2. 44; R. 12. 37; Ve. 1. 25; U. 4. 23; Mu. 3. 4; Mv. 1. 40, 3. 17. --2 Defeat, discomfiture. --Comp. --आस्पदं, --पदं {1} an object of contempt; H. 3. 51. {2} a disgrace or disgraceful situation. --विधिः humiliation; प्रायो मूर्खः परिभवविधौ नाभिमानं तनोति Ś. Til. 16.

k.v: गर्वोऽभिमानोऽहङ्कारो मानश्चित्तसमुन्नतिः। दर्पोऽवलोकोऽवष्टम्भश्चित्तोद्रेकः स्मयो मदः। अनादरः परिभवः परीभावस्तिरस्क्रिया॥

m: परि-भवनीय mfn. liable to be insulted or offended or humiliated, Mālav.; Kād.; Kathās.
परि-भव—पद n. an object or occasion of contempt, Kālid.; Hit.

v: tri॰ pari + BU--tAcCIlye ini । pariBavanaSIle striyAM NIp ।
m: परि-भविन् mfn. injuring, despising, ridiculing, Inscr.
a: परिभविन् — a. (नी f.) 1 Humiliating, treating with disrespect or contempt. --2 Suffering disrespect.

m: परि-भय m. or n. (√ भी) apprehension, fear, Śaṃk.

परि-√ भृ P. Ā. -भरति, ˚ते (pf. P. -बभ्रिम [!] BhP.; Ā. -जभ्रे, RV.), to bring, RV.; (Ā.) to extend or pass beyond, ib. (also trans. = extend, spread, i, 97, 15); to roam or travel about, BhP. (cf. above).
परि-भृष्ट mfn. fried, roasted, parched, Suśr.
परि-√ भिद् Pass. -भिद्यते, to be broken or destroyed, MBh.
परि-भिन्न mfn. (परि-) broken, split or cleft open, crumbled, ŚBr.; R.
a: परिभिन्न — p. p. 1 Split open, cracked. --2 Deformed.

illegal use of another's goods, W.
means of subsistence or enjoyment, MBh.
a: परिभोगः — 1 Enjoyment; R. 4. 45. --2 Especially, sexual enjoyment; R. 11. 52, 19. 21, 28, 30. --3 IIlegal use of another's goods.

m: living at another's cost, Mn. ii, 201.
a: परिभोक्तृ — a. 1 Eating, enjoying, possessing. --2 Living at another's cost, using another's property illegally.

m: परि-√ भ्राज् (only pf. -बभ्राज), to shed brilliance all around, R.
परि-भ्रामण n. (fr. Caus.) turning to and fro, BhP.
परि-भ्रामिन् mfn. moving hither and thither in (comp.), Bālar.
परि-√ भ्रंश् only pr. p. Ā. in अ-परिभ्रश्यमान mfn. not escaping, Kām.
a: परिभ्रंश् — {c1c} A., {c4c} P. 1 To fall or drop down, tumble, slip. --2 To stray from, go astray. --3 To fall away from, swerve, deviate. --4 To lose, be deprived of; Ms. 10. 20. --5 To escape. --6 To neglect, omit. --7 To disappear.
परिभ्रंशः — 1 Escape. --2 Falling from.

m: परि-भ्रंशन n. falling from, loss of (abl.), Pañc.
a: परिभ्रंशनं — Falling from. --Losse.

m: परि-√ भ्रज्ज् only pr. p. -भृज्ज्यत् (with pass. meaning, MBh. [B.] xi, 97 C., -भुज्यत्) and Caus. -भर्जयति (Bhpr.), to fry, roast, parch.

परि-√ भ्रम् P. -भ्रमति, -भ्राम्यति (ep. also ˚ते; pr. p. -भ्रमत्, -भ्राम्यत् and -भ्रममाण; pf. -बभ्राम, 3. pl. -बभ्रमुः, or -भ्रेमुः; ind.p. -भ्रम्य; inf. -भ्रमितुम् or -भ्रान्तुम्), to rove, ramble, wander about or through, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; (also with मण्डलम्) to turn or whirl round, move in a circle, describe a c˚ round, revolve, rotate, MaitrUp.; Hariv.; R.; BhP. : Caus. -भ्रामयति, to stir up, shake through, Bhpr.
a: परिभ्रम् — {c1c} {c4c} P. 1 To rove, wander about, ramble, move to and fro; परिभ्रमसि किं वृथा क्वचन चित्त विश्रम्यताम् Bh. 3. 137. --2 To hover, whirl round; परिभ्रमन्मूर्धजषट्पदाकुलैः Ki. 5. 14. --3 To revolve, rotate, move or turn round. --4 To wander or roam over (with acc.); भुवं परिबभ्राम. --5 To turn round (anything), circumambulate. --6 To encircle. --Caus. To bewilder, overwhelm, overpower; U. 3. 32.

s: puM, (pari + Bram + ac .) sarvvatoBramaRam । paripUrvvaBramaDAtorBAve alpratyayanizpannaH ॥
m: परि-भ्रम mfn. flying round or about (see खे-परिभ्र्˚)
परि-भ्रम m. wandering, going about, BhP.
a: परिभ्रमः — 1 Wandering, going about. --2 Rambling discourse, circumlocution, periphrasis. --3 Error, delusion.

v: na॰ parito BramaRam । 1 sarvatoBramaRe 2 paryyawane ca
m: परि-भ्रमण n. turning round, revolving (as of wheels), BhP.
moving to and fro, going about, Prasaṅg.
a: परिभ्रमणं — 1 Going about, roaming, wandering. --2 Revolving, turning round. --3 Circumference.

m: परि-भ्रष्ट mfn. fallen or dropped off
deprived of (abl. or comp., rarely instr.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: परिभ्रष्ट — p. p. 1 Fallen or dropped off. --2 Escaped. --3 Cast down, degraded. --4 Deprived of, devoid of (with abl. or instr.); Pt. 4. 93. --5 Neglecting. --6 Vanished. --7 Lost.

m: परि-भ्रष्ट—सत्कर्मन् mfn. one whose virtuous acts are lost or in vain, BhP.
परि-भ्रष्ट—सुख mfn. fallen from happiness, MBh.
परि-भुग्न mfn. bowed, bent, Bhaṭṭ. (Pāṇ. viii, 4, 31, Sch.)
a: परिभुग्न — a. Bowed, curved, bent.

m: परि-√ 1. भुज् P. -भुजति, (-अबुभोजीर्, RV. i, 33, 9), to span, encompass, embrace, RV.; VS.; TāṇḍBr.
परि-√ 3. भुज् P. Ā. -भुनक्ति, -भुङ्क्ते, (inf. -भोक्तुम्), to eat before another (with acc.), MBh.; to neglect to feed, BhP.; to feed upon, eat, consume, enjoy, Kāv.; Sāh.
a: परिभुज् — {c7c} U. 1 To eat. --2 To use, enjoy; न खलु च परिभेक्तुं नैव शक्नोमि ह तुं Ś. 5. 19; Ki. 5. 5; 8. 57. --3 To neglect to feed.

m: परि-भुक्त mfn. eaten before another, anticipated in eating, MBh.
a: परिभुक्त — p. p. 1 Eaten. --2 Used, enjoyed. --3 Possessed.
